question: True or false: every fraction between 0 and 1 can be covered by intervals whose lengths add up to a millionth?
answer: True. The fractions can be put in a single list. Cover the first with an interval half a millionth long, the second with a quarter of a millionth, and so on, halving each time: the lengths add up to a millionth, yet every fraction is covered, although there is a fraction between any two numbers.
move: Something can be everywhere and still take up no room.
trap: Fractions are everywhere on the line, so covering them covers everything.
reference: Royden & Fitzpatrick, Real Analysis, 4th edition, Pearson, 2010
